description: Irrigation Department - Minute of the Engineering Assistant's Service of the Irrigation Department w.e.f. 11.02.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification pertains specifically to public service matters, detailing the service minute for Engineering Assistants in the Irrigation Department. It covers public service recruitment classifications, salary scales, allowances, job duties, and administrative procedures under the authority of the Public Service Commission. This falls under Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) as it deals with public sector service conditions, classifications, and administration rather than government structure/personnel changes or other specialized categories.
